title: Main / Reviewer
scope: Global architecture, cross-lane review, consolidation, roadmap/state authority and hardening, including target inference profile balance and shared-contract compatibility.

active_claim.scope: Add transactional control-plane mutation inbox with validate-before-apply semantics and quarantine so malformed automation/API requests cannot corrupt workstreams or blind global projection.

next_action: Migrate mutating automation state writes to the transactional inbox, then proceed to CP-HARDEN-02 resource-level conflict locks.

completed_work.summary: Canonical chat registry, generated lane bootstraps, claim-bound review packets, submit-review transition and validation/tests merged.
Recovered historical chat-only work into canonical roadmaps/workstreams, added deletion-safe archive policy and backlog visibility.
Continuous checkpoints now persist safe resume state throughout work and final review handoff.
Added autonomous checkpoint freshness watchdog to canonical projection.
Registered bounded Cantiere automation pilot and deletion-safe replacement of Cantiere 2.6.
Reviewer intake no longer depends on a possibly stale projection; explicit accept/rework transitions and atomic handoff rules are operational.
Hardened control-plane lifecycle integrity after first autonomous Cantiere pilot.
Restored green main validation after archiving real pilot review history.
Closed remaining post-PR89 lifecycle gaps and documented structural hardening still required.

checkpoints.summary: Continuous autonomous chat checkpointing implemented, validated and merged via PR #85.
decisions: Do not depend on detecting native chat context exhaustion.
Persist material progress event-by-event during work.
Replacement chats resume from canonical state plus last_checkpoint.
checkpoints.next_action: Use continuous checkpoints automatically in every claimed lane; user intervention is not required for normal chat rollover.

checkpoints.summary: Checkpoint freshness watchdog implemented, tested and merged via PR #86.
decisions: Warn after 120 minutes without a current-claim checkpoint.
Surface to Main/Reviewer instead of fabricating content.
Do not auto-block before normal claim lease expiry.
checkpoints.next_action: Use projection.checkpoint_watch to detect lanes that may be working without recently persisted resume state.

checkpoints.summary: First bounded autonomous chat pilot registered for Cantiere and old Cantiere 2.6 promoted to deletion candidate via PR #87.
decisions: Pilot limited to 4 hourly cycles.
One bounded Cantiere work item per cycle.
Stop at Main/Reviewer or physical-owner gates.
checkpoints.next_action: Observe first Cantiere Auto-Pilot cycles and compare canonical checkpoints/results before enabling additional chat lanes.

checkpoints.summary: Reviewer pipeline repaired. PR #88 merged, raw workstreams are now authoritative for reviewer intake, review-accept/review-rework transitions exist, and the Cantiere #745 malformed handoff was repaired and reviewed without claiming physical acceptance.
decisions: Reviewer must scan raw workstream files, not projection.review_required alone.
Status-only REVIEW_REQUIRED handoffs are forbidden.
Cantiere #745 implementation is approved; Phase 1 ONLINE remains open for physical Manga Kids retest.
checkpoints.next_action: Let the automatic Main/Reviewer scan raw lanes on each cycle; Cantiere next gate is a bounded physical Manga Kids retest on a release containing #745.

checkpoints.summary: Post-pilot control-plane audit completed. PR #89 hardened per-claim reset, lease expiry, review schema, required review gates and roadmap-sync semantics. Windows Legacy automation was migrated to canonical lane rules and Cantiere pilot metadata was closed/cleaned.
decisions: A new claim must not inherit reviewer approval, evidence, review packet or PASS gates.
Expired claims cannot be revived by heartbeat/checkpoint.
Review packets must conform to canonical schema, not only contain required keys.
Material roadmap impact keeps G7 pending until synchronization is actually verified.
Enabled mutating automations must operate through a canonical lane.
checkpoints.next_action: Address remaining structural hardening: pre-commit state mutation guard, resource-level conflict locks, unclaimed external-change ingress detection, then AIR-10 dispatcher.

checkpoints.summary: Post-hardening test isolation fixed. PR #90 merged after full Library validation passed.
decisions: Persisted review history is valid fixture state and tests must not assume an empty repository history.
checkpoints.next_action: Proceed with structural backlog CP-HARDEN-01..05; no active incident remains in the control plane.

checkpoints.summary: Second-pass control-plane audit completed. PR #92 merged remaining lifecycle safeguards; stale Windows projection incident repaired; legacy split-brain PR #59 and conflicted duplicate PR #91 closed; Reviewer and Windows automations were constrained to canonical ownership rules.
decisions: Do not allow Reviewer automation to take over active main-reviewer implementation claims.
A malformed checkpoint is an incident because it can blind global projection until repaired.
Keep remaining structural hardening explicit rather than declaring the control plane fully autonomous.
checkpoints.next_action: Prioritize CP-HARDEN-01 atomic mutation/projection isolation, then CP-HARDEN-02 serialized resource locks and CP-HARDEN-04 canonical automation registry before broad AIR-10 dispatch.

checkpoints.summary: CP-HARDEN-01 implemented and merged via PR #93. Transactional compare-and-swap mutation inbox, quarantine receipts, and per-lane projection incident isolation are operational.
decisions: Operational API writers must not edit workstream or canonical-state JSON directly on main.
Invalid or stale mutation requests are quarantined without changing lane state.
Unreadable lanes are isolated in projection_incidents instead of blinding healthy lanes.
checkpoints.next_action: Migrate mutating automation state writes to the transactional inbox, then proceed to CP-HARDEN-02 resource-level conflict locks.

hardening_backlog.title: Pre-commit canonical state mutation guard
hardening_backlog.problem: Direct API/main writes can place an invalid lane state on main before post-push validation catches it; one malformed lane can also make the global reconcile/validation workflow fail and leave the canonical projection stale.
hardening_backlog.target: Route worker/reviewer state transitions through an atomic validated mutation path or equivalent protected update gate, and isolate/quarantine invalid-lane projection failures so one lane cannot blind the whole control plane.
hardening_backlog.implementation: Transactional compare-and-swap inbox + per-lane projection incident isolation.

hardening_backlog.title: Resource-level conflict locks
hardening_backlog.problem: Duplicate protection uses exact work_item identity and separate lane files; simultaneous cross-lane claims or different work_item names can still overlap the same files/contracts/resources.
hardening_backlog.target: Add serialized claim authority plus explicit resource/scope lock keys with conflict detection while preserving safe parallel platform work.

hardening_backlog.title: Unclaimed external-change ingress detection
hardening_backlog.problem: Repository work can merge without any canonical lane claim/checkpoint. PR #747 is a current example: roadmap captured it, workstream claim history did not.
hardening_backlog.target: Main/Reviewer detects relevant merged PRs/commits without a matching lane claim and requires reconciliation before treating them as canonical progress.

hardening_backlog.title: Canonical automation registry
hardening_backlog.problem: Scheduled mutating tasks can exist outside lane ownership or overreach their role. During this audit the automatic Reviewer continued the active main-reviewer hardening claim and produced PR #89 in parallel.
hardening_backlog.target: Register enabled mutating automations to lane ids and role capabilities; reject/flag unowned automation and forbid Reviewer takeover of active main-reviewer implementation claims.

hardening_backlog.title: Roadmap dispatcher
hardening_backlog.problem: READY lanes still do not autonomously select and execute roadmap work; only specifically scheduled automations advance.
hardening_backlog.target: Complete AIR-10 bounded dispatcher with claim, checkpoint, reviewer and physical-gate semantics.

hardening_backlog.title: Evidence-backed canonical sync receipts
hardening_backlog.problem: canonical-sync-complete currently verifies referenced roadmap identifiers but does not cryptographically prove that the referenced roadmap content actually changed to match the accepted work.
hardening_backlog.target: Record before/after content digest or commit/ref evidence for every material roadmap synchronization before G7 can become PASS.
